# loading seurat object
```{r}
BAL_macrophages <- load_clean_bal_seurat()
gene_ensb <- BAL_macrophages@misc$features$SYMBOL
names(gene_ensb) <- BAL_macrophages@misc$features$ENSEMBL
features <- BAL_macrophages@misc$features
cluster_names <- c("Monocytes" , "MonoM" , "CD163LGMNM" ,    "AM1"  ,  "AM2"  ,   "ProlifAM")

```

```{r}
color.cluster <- c(
  "Monocytes"     = "#009E73",
  "MonoM"       = "#E69F00",
  "CD163LGMNM" = "#D55E00",
  "AM1"         = "#A020F0",
  "AM2"         = "#0072B2",
  "ProlifAM"   = "#56B4E9"
)
BAL_macrophages@misc$colors$Cluster <- color.cluster
```

```{r}
ipf_vs_ctr_adams <- read_tsv("https://www.science.org/doi/suppl/10.1126/sciadv.aba1983/suppl_file/aba1983_data_s8.txt")
cn <- colnames(ipf_vs_ctr_adams %>% clean_names())[1:7] %>% c("row_number",.)
colnames(ipf_vs_ctr_adams) <- cn
ipf_vs_copd_adams <- read_tsv("https://www.science.org/doi/suppl/10.1126/sciadv.aba1983/suppl_file/aba1983_data_s10.txt")
cn <- colnames(ipf_vs_copd_adams %>% clean_names())[1:7] %>% c("row_number",.)
colnames(ipf_vs_copd_adams) <- cn

copd_vs_ctr_adams <- read_tsv("https://www.science.org/doi/suppl/10.1126/sciadv.aba1983/suppl_file/aba1983_data_s9.txt")
cn <- colnames(copd_vs_ctr_adams %>% clean_names())[1:7] %>% c("row_number",.)
colnames(copd_vs_ctr_adams) <- cn
```

```{r}
ipf_vs_ctr_adams$cell_type %>% unique()
ipf_vs_ctr_adams %>% filter(cell_type=="Macrophage", log1p_fc>0, wilcox_p<0.01) %>% arrange(wilcox_p) %>% head(50)
ipf_vs_ctr_adams %>% filter(cell_type=="Macrophage", log1p_fc<0, wilcox_p<0.01) %>% arrange(wilcox_p) %>% head(50)
ipf_vs_ctr_adams %>% filter(cell_type=="Macrophage Alveolar", log1p_fc>0) %>% arrange(wilcox_p) %>% head(50)


```

```{r}
ipf_vs_copd_adams %>% filter(cell_type=="Macrophage", log1p_fc>0) %>% arrange(wilcox_p)
ipf_vs_copd_adams %>% filter(cell_type=="Macrophage Alveolar", log1p_fc>0) %>% arrange(wilcox_p)
```

```{r}
####
adams_dif_set <- ipf_vs_ctr_adams %>% filter(cell_type=="Macrophage Alveolar", log1p_fc>0) %>% arrange(wilcox_p) %>% head(50) %>% pull(gene) %>% 
  list(mac_alv_ipf_vs_ctr=.)

adams_dif_set[["mac_ipf_vs_ctr"]] <- ipf_vs_ctr_adams %>% filter(cell_type=="Macrophage", log1p_fc>0) %>% arrange(wilcox_p) %>% head(50) %>% pull(gene) 

adams_dif_set[["mac_alv_ipf_vs_copd"]] <- ipf_vs_copd_adams %>% filter(cell_type=="Macrophage Alveolar", log1p_fc>0) %>% arrange(wilcox_p) %>% head(50) %>% pull(gene)

adams_dif_set[["mac_alv_copd_vs_ipf"]] <- ipf_vs_copd_adams %>% filter(cell_type=="Macrophage Alveolar", log1p_fc<0) %>% arrange(wilcox_p) %>% head(50) %>% pull(gene)

adams_dif_set[["mac_ctr_vs_ipf"]] <- ipf_vs_ctr_adams %>% filter(cell_type=="Macrophage", log1p_fc<0) %>% arrange(wilcox_p) %>% head(50) %>% pull(gene) 

adams_dif_set[["mac_copd_vs_ipf"]] <- ipf_vs_copd_adams %>% filter(cell_type=="Macrophage", log1p_fc<0) %>% arrange(wilcox_p) %>% head(50) %>% pull(gene)

adams_dif_set[["mac_ctr_vs_copd"]] <- copd_vs_ctr_adams %>% filter(cell_type=="Macrophage", log1p_fc<0) %>% arrange(wilcox_p) %>% head(50) %>% pull(gene)


adams_dif_set[["mac_copd_vs_ctr"]] <- copd_vs_ctr_adams %>% filter(cell_type=="Macrophage Alveolar", log1p_fc>0) %>% arrange(wilcox_p) %>% head(50) %>% pull(gene)

scores_adams <- dings@meta.data[, which(
  stringr::str_detect(string = names(dings@meta.data), pattern = "adams_dif")
)]

limits_adj <- c(min(scores_adams),max(scores_adams))



dings <- BAL_macrophages
dings <-   add_named_module_score( 
  seurat_object   = BAL_macrophages, 
  genesets_list_named = adams_dif_set %>% lapply(function(x) ensemblizer(x)),
  score_id = "adams_dif"
)
```

```{r}
module_score_umaps(object = dings,pattern = "adams_dif", limits = limits_adj )
module_score_umaps(object = dings,pattern = "adams_dif", limits = c(-0.5,1) )
```


```{r}


data_adams <- extract_score_data(seurat_obj = dings, scores=scores_adams, score_id = "adams_dif")%>% 
  mutate(Cluster= factor(Cluster, levels=cluster_names),
         Geneset=str_replace_all(Geneset, pattern= "adams_dif", replacement = "") %>% factor())

ps_adams <- wilcox_cluster_to_rest(data = data_adams, geneset_var = "Geneset", cluster_var="Cluster")
ggplot2::ggplot(
  data = data_adams,
  mapping = ggplot2::aes(
    x    = Cluster,
    y    = Score,
    col  = col,
    fill = Cluster
  )
) +score_violin_theme(limits = limits_adj, p_score=ps_adams)
```

```{r}
dings %>% SetIdent(value="patient") %>%  VlnPlot(features = str_subset(dings@meta.data %>% names, pattern = "adams_dif") )

tibble(sex=BAL_macrophages$sex, donor=BAL_macrophages$patient) %>% distinct()
```
